clue.text: Fulfilled expert

definitions.meaning: first meaning: achieved or carried out successfully

explanation.surface: A specialist who feels content and satisfied with their working life.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a task successfully completed and a person showing great skill at something.

clue.text: Examiner of car on hill

parts.note: a German make of car
a tor is a rocky hill, common on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: Someone inspecting a vehicle parked on a slope.
explanation.definitionFit: An auditor is an official who inspects company accounts, so a kind of examiner.

clue.text: Caught everyone in ring

parts.note: C is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught
everyone means all of them

explanation.surface: Everybody rounded up inside a boxing ring or circus ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ring' reads as an arena, but it is a verb meaning to telephone.
explanation.definitionFit: To ring someone is British usage for phoning them, which is the same as giving them a telephone call.

clue.text: Hitched sheep up right before initially inserting electronic device

clue.text: Field force to meet large alien flier

explanation.definitionFit: A flier, or flyer, is a single printed sheet handed out to advertise something, just like a handbill.

clue.text: Very hot old London area

parts.note: so means very, as in so good

explanation.surface: A historic part of the capital that is sweltering, or perhaps fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Soho is a district of the West End of central London known for nightlife and restaurants.

clue.text: Balancing time

definitions.meaning: first meaning: making level or equal
second meaning: the part of the day after afternoon

explanation.walkthrough: It reads like a juggler's timing, but the two words are separate meanings of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: Making things level is evening them out, and the late part of the day is also called by this word.

clue.text: Tact is largely deployed in considered fashion

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Diplomacy is mostly used in a thoughtful way.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'is' belongs to the letters; 'largely' looks like it means mostly but is used whole.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting strategically means acting according to a deliberate plan, which is doing things in a thought-out manner.

clue.text: Show evil spirit right inside depot

clue.text: After time line is crossed by more peculiar child

explanation.definitionFit: A toddler is a young child just learning to walk, so a specific kind of child.

clue.text: Two articles about permit for sportswoman

parts.note: the indefinite article a followed by the definite article the
to let is to permit

explanation.surface: Two newspaper pieces discuss a licence for a female sports star.
explanation.walkthrough: 'articles' suggests newspaper stories, but these are grammar's a and the.
explanation.definitionFit: An athlete is a person who competes in sport, so a female athlete is a sportswoman.

clue.text: Narrates regularly showing skills

parts.note: the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters

explanation.definitionFit: Arts are crafts or abilities acquired by practice, as in the arts of persuasion, so they are skills.

clue.text: Silicon Valley disposing of a creep

the letter that is removed

clue.text: Heads of logistics irrationally make order for large car

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: the first letter of each of these four words

explanation.definitionFit: A limo, short for limousine, is a long luxurious chauffeur-driven vehicle.

clue.text: Torment in the past extremely nasty

explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' wants to mean very, but it picks the ends of the next word.
explanation.definitionFit: Agony is intense physical or mental suffering, the same as torment.

clue.text: Group of witches caught by stove

indicators.note: by means next to, so the two pieces stand side by side

parts.note: C is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught
an oven is part of a stove

explanation.definitionFit: A coven is a gathering of witches who meet regularly, traditionally thirteen of them.

clue.text: Infuriated as English garden is destroyed

indicators.note: something destroyed is broken apart, so these letters are scattered and reassembled

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for English
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone is furious when their English garden is wrecked.
explanation.definitionFit: Enraged means made extremely angry, which is what infuriated also means.

clue.text: Gutters uneven in middle of streetscapes

rough means bumpy or uneven

clue.text: Popular number by South European is profound

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
ten is a number

explanation.walkthrough: 'number' suggests a song in the charts, but it is simply a numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense and profound both describe feelings of great depth or strength.

clue.text: Partly seethe at revolting drama

clue.text: Former lover criticizes eastern area

clue.text: Lap up state song and dance

clue.text: Disparage the setter's fruit

clue.text: Rewrite mean last word

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Charm of exchange involving papa

clue.text: Ejected Tiff

definitions.meaning: first meaning: forced out of the mouth, past tense of a verb

clue.text: Bit of stuff I made up to annoy

clue.text: Victor left tin between two holes in Krakatoa perhaps
